hero.title: Software for businesses that can think, operate,
hero.lede: We engineer intelligent software, autonomous systems, and the infrastructure that turns them into real business operations.
hero.support: Digit uses that technology to build and operate businesses of its own, creating systems that learn from experience and become more capable over time.

company.headline: Building the technology behind a new kind of business.
company.lead: Digit Software develops technology that helps businesses take on more of their own operation.
body: We use that technology across businesses we own in e-commerce, media, marketing, web solutions, and software development. Running those businesses gives us a practical way to test what we build, learn from real operations, and find out where the technology needs to get better.
Over time, the same technology can support businesses outside Digit through software products, infrastructure, and systems built for their operations.

businesses.headline: Businesses built to operate differently.
body: Digit owns and manages a portfolio of businesses across e-commerce, media, marketing, web solutions, and software development.
Each one gives us real problems to solve, real results to measure, and a place to put our technology to work. What we learn from operating these businesses goes back into the software we build.

e-commerce.title: E-Commerce
e-commerce.body: Digital commerce businesses combining product development, research, intelligent operations, and technology-driven distribution.

media.title: Media
media.body: Digital media businesses combining scalable content systems, technology-enabled production, and modern distribution.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.body: Technology-driven marketing focused on customer acquisition, digital growth, automation, experimentation, and measurable performance.

web-solutions.title: Web Solutions
web-solutions.body: Web development and digital infrastructure spanning websites, platforms, domains, hosting, integrations, and connected business systems.

software-development.title: Software Development
software-development.body: Software engineering spanning SaaS, intelligent applications, automation, operational platforms, and autonomous infrastructure.

platform.headline: Software that's intelligent enough to run businesses.
body: Most business software gives people tools to do their jobs. Ours is built to take on more of the work itself.

The platform brings together specialized agents, software for coordinating their work, shared intelligence built from what the business learns, and the infrastructure needed to turn decisions into actions.

mission-control.name: Mission Control
mission-control.body: See what is happening across the business, what needs attention, how work is progressing, and where a decision is needed.

agents.name: Agents
agents.body: Agents research, analyze, create, review, monitor, and carry out work across different parts of the business.

cerebro.name: Cerebro
cerebro.body: Knowledge, evidence, experience, procedures, and decisions stay connected and available to the systems that need them.

execution.name: Execution
execution.body: The execution layer coordinates agents, connects them to the systems they need, and keeps track of what happens along the way.

technology.headline: The infrastructure behind intelligent businesses.
body: An agent can complete a task. Running part of a business is a much larger engineering problem.

Work has to be coordinated across different systems and capabilities. Context has to carry from one task to the next. Software needs controlled access to outside tools and services. Failures have to be handled. Decisions and actions need to be visible. What the business learns needs to remain useful after the work is done.
technology.closing: We build that infrastructure from the ground up.

items.title: Execution
items.body: Turn objectives into work and carry that work through.

items.title: Specialized Agents
items.body: Use different capabilities for different kinds of work.

items.title: Knowledge
items.body: Keep useful context and experience beyond a single task.

items.title: Learning
items.body: Use results from past work to improve future work.

items.title: Governance
items.body: Control what software is allowed to do.

items.title: Integrations
items.body: Connect work to the systems businesses already use.

items.title: Observability
items.body: See what happened, when it happened, and why.

items.title: Resilience
items.body: Recover from problems without losing the state of the work.

autonomy.headline: Autonomy with limits.
autonomy.lead: Digit can handle routine work without waiting for approval at every step. Some decisions still belong with the people responsible for the business.
autonomy.body: Spending, security, company direction, external commitments, and actions that are difficult to reverse can require a person before anything happens. The software operates within those limits.

reserved.title: Security
reserved.body: Access, credentials, permissions, and sensitive changes.

reserved.title: Direction
reserved.body: Strategy and decisions that materially change the business.

reserved.title: External Actions
reserved.body: Important actions that represent or commit the business.

reserved.title: Irreversible Actions
reserved.body: Decisions that cannot easily be undone.

improvement.headline: Software that learns from its operations.
improvement.lede: Digit learns from results, failures, experiments, and new evidence produced through its work. What proves useful can become part of how future work is planned, performed, and evaluated.

steps.title: Operate
steps.body: Work gets done toward a business objective.

steps.title: Observe
steps.body: The system keeps a record of what happened.

steps.title: Measure
steps.body: Results are compared with what the business was trying to achieve.

steps.title: Learn
steps.body: Useful results and patterns become knowledge the business can use again.

steps.title: Adapt
steps.body: What the business learns can change how similar work is handled.

steps.title: Improve
steps.body: The next operation starts with what the business learned from the last one.

ledger.body: A way to test an idea.
Something the business can learn from.

contact.headline: Interested in what we're building?
contact.body: If you're working on similar problems, interested in the technology, or want to learn more about Digit Software, we'd like to hear from you.
